change_list: In finite-body project() only, added cam.dist to projected Z depth. Infinite-star projectDir() was not changed.
Assigned the Sun's projected radius SUN._s.pr exactly as every planet branch already assigns p._s.pr.
reason: The generated camera updated cam.dist but project() ignored it, making bodies invisible. Once visible, drawSun received an undefined projected radius because the Sun branch omitted .pr.
publication_rule: Any capture from this copy must be labeled as a two-line display repair. The original visual verdict remains fail_major.
